req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-009 requires HTTP 404 with detail containing 'Task not found' (actual message is 'Task with id {task_id} not found') when GET /tasks/{task_id} is called with a non-existent ID. The table is EMPTY before every test, so any positive-path test must first create a task. Tests cover: (1) NEG/EP — request a clearly non-existent ID in an empty DB, assert exact 404 and exact detail string; (2) positive — create a task then retrieve it by its real ID, assert 200 and exact payload fields; (3) BVA — use task_id=0 (below the minimum auto-increment PK of 1) to confirm 404; (4) BVA boundary+1 — create one task (id=1), then request id=2 (one above the only existing id) to confirm 404; (5) DT — verify that after deletion the same id returns 404, confirming state-dependent routing. Each test uses an in-memory SQLite override via dependency injection to remain isolated and deterministic.

tests.name: test_get_nonexistent_task_returns_404_empty_db
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send GET /tasks/9999 where 9999 does not exist in the empty database
expected: Response JSON detail contains 'Task with id 9999 not found'
trace: R-TASK-009: system shall respond with HTTP 404 when id does not exist
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_nonexistent_task_returns_404_empty_db():
    r = client.get('/tasks/9999')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    body = r.json()
    assert body['detail'] == 'Task with id 9999 not found'

test_get_nonexistent_task_returns_404_empty_db()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

def test_get_deleted_task_returns_404():
    cr = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Doomed Task', 'completed': False})
